email_body:
Dear Hiring Team,

I'm writing to apply for the Customer Services Executive role at IWG. Your emphasis on warm welcomes, smooth daily operations, and helping people have a great day at work resonates with how I approach my own work.

In my current roles, I manage websites and client content, which requires clear communication, a positive attitude, and the ability to learn quickly. I regularly interact with clients and team members, solving problems and keeping projects on track. I'm comfortable taking direction and applying new skills with confidence—whether it's mastering a new CMS or automating a process.

What draws me to IWG is the chance to be part of a global team where customer service is at the heart of the business. I'm eager to bring my outgoing, can-do mindset to a role that directly impacts how customers and colleagues experience their workday.

I'd welcome the opportunity to discuss how my skills align with your needs. Thank you for your consideration.

Warm regards,
Baver Ok

cover_letter:
Dear Hiring Team,

I am excited to apply for the Customer Services Executive position at IWG. The role's focus on delivering world-class service and creating a positive environment for customers and colleagues aligns perfectly with my professional values and experience.

In my current roles as a freelance SEO specialist and junior digital marketer, I interact daily with clients and team members, managing website content and solving problems to ensure smooth operations. For example, I build and maintain WordPress sites for clients, which requires clear communication, a proactive attitude, and the ability to learn new tools quickly. I also collaborate remotely with colleagues, coordinating tasks and providing updates—skills that translate directly to the on-site coordination required in this role.

What excites me about IWG is the opportunity to be part of a dynamic, global team where customer service is central. I thrive in people-facing situations and enjoy helping others have a great day. My experience in fast-paced digital environments has taught me to adapt quickly, take direction, and apply new skills with confidence—qualities I believe are essential for this role.

I am eager to bring my outgoing, can-do mindset to IWG and contribute to a welcoming atmosphere for customers and colleagues. I am confident that my communication skills and determination to improve every day will make a positive impact.

Thank you for considering my application. I look forward to the opportunity to discuss how I can contribute to your team.

Sincerely,
Baver Ok

cv_highlights:
• Fluent in English and native Turkish, with basic Dutch—strong communication skills for diverse customer interactions.
